The most specific and recent figure comes from Wikipedia's bibliography page [d1], which states King has published 65 novels/novellas, including seven under the pen name Richard Bachman. The variation is best explained by the fact that King continues to publish regularly, making older sources quickly outdated [d2], and some sources use rounded or approximate figures rather than precise counts.
